module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert between integers and Roman numerals.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: Errors for invalid Roman numeral conversions.
  InvalidInteger(value: Integer)
  InvalidRoman(text: Text)
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 into a Roman numeral.
  example: to_roman(value: 1994) is "MCMXCIV"

  if value is less than 1 then
    fail with InvalidInteger(value: value)
  end

  if value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidInteger(value: value)
  end

  let thousands be value.quotient(1000)
  let hundreds be value.remainder(1000).quotient(100)
  let tens be value.remainder(100).quotient(10)
  let ones be value.remainder(10)

  let result be ""

  if thousands is 3 then
    set result to result + "MMM"
  otherwise if thousands is 2 then
    set result to result + "MM"
  otherwise if thousands is 1 then
    set result to result + "M"
  end

  if hundreds is 9 then
    set result to result + "CM"
  otherwise if hundreds is 8 then
    set result to result + "DCCC"
  otherwise if hundreds is 7 then
    set result to result + "DCC"
  otherwise if hundreds is 6 then
    set result to result + "DC"
  otherwise if hundreds is 5 then
    set result to result + "D"
  otherwise if hundreds is 4 then
    set result to result + "CD"
  otherwise if hundreds is 3 then
    set result to result + "CCC"
  otherwise if hundreds is 2 then
    set result to result + "CC"
  otherwise if hundreds is 1 then
    set result to result + "C"
  end

  if tens is 9 then
    set result to result + "XC"
  otherwise if tens is 8 then
    set result to result + "LXXX"
  otherwise if tens is 7 then
    set result to result + "LXX"
  otherwise if tens is 6 then
    set result to result + "LX"
  otherwise if tens is 5 then
    set result to result + "L"
  otherwise if tens is 4 then
    set result to result + "XL"
  otherwise if tens is 3 then
    set result to result + "XXX"
  otherwise if tens is 2 then
    set result to result + "XX"
  otherwise if tens is 1 then
    set result to result + "X"
  end

  if ones is 9 then
    set result to result + "IX"
  otherwise if ones is 8 then
    set result to result + "VIII"
  otherwise if ones is 7 then
    set result to result + "VII"
  otherwise if ones is 6 then
    set result to result + "VI"
  otherwise if ones is 5 then
    set result to result + "V"
  otherwise if ones is 4 then
    set result to result + "IV"
  otherwise if ones is 3 then
    set result to result + "III"
  otherwise if ones is 2 then
    set result to result + "II"
  otherwise if ones is 1 then
    set result to result + "I"
  end

  return result
end

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral into an integer from 1 to 3999.
  example: from_roman(text: "MCMXCIV") is 1994

  if text.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
  end

  let mutable index be 0
  let mutable total be 0

  repeat until index is at least text.length()
    let remaining be text.drop(index)

    if remaining.starts_with("M") then

      set index to index + 1

      set total to total + 500
      set index to index + 1
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("CD") then
      set total to total + 400
      set index to index + 2
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("CCC") then
      set total to total + 300
      set index to index + 3
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("CC") then
      set total to total + 200

      set total to total + 100
      set index to index + 1
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("XC") then
      set total to total + 90
      set index to index + 2
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("LXXX") then
      set total to total + 80
      set index to index + 4
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("LXX") then
      set total to total + 70
      set index to index + 3
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("LX") then
      set total to total + 60
      set index to index + 2
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("L") then
      set total to total + 50
      set index to index + 1
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("XL") then
      set total to total + 40
      set index to index + 2
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("XXX") then
      set total to total + 30
      set index to index + 3
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("XX") then
      set total to total + 20
      set index to index + 2
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("X") then
      set total to total + 10
      set index to index + 1
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("IX") then
      set total to total + 9
      set index to index + 2
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("VIII") then
      set total to total + 8
      set index to index + 4
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("VII") then
      set total to total + 7
      set index to index + 3
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("VI") then
      set total to total + 6
      set index to index + 2
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("V") then
      set total to total + 5
      set index to index + 1
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("IV") then
      set total to total + 4
      set index to index + 2
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("III") then
      set total to total + 3
      set index to index + 3
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("II") then
      set total to total + 2
      set index to index + 2
    otherwise if remaining.starts_with("I") then
      set total to total + 1
      set index to index + 1
    otherwise
      fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
    end
  end

  if total is less than 1 then
    fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
  end

  if total is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
  end

  if to_roman(value: total) is not text then
    fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
  end

  return total
end

module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert between integers and Roman numerals.

public type RomanError
  purpose: An error for invalid Roman numeral input.
  has message: Text
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 into a Roman numeral.
  example: to_roman(value: 1994) is "MCMXCIV"

  if value is less than 1 then
    fail with RomanError(message: "value must be at least 1")
  otherwise if value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with RomanError(message: "value must be at most 3999")
  otherwise
    let thousands be value.quotient(1000)
    let hundreds be value.remainder(1000).quotient(100)
    let tens be value.remainder(100).quotient(10)
    let ones be value.remainder(10)

    let result be ""

    set result to result + repeat "M" thousands
    set result to result + digit_to_roman(digit: hundreds, one: "C", five: "D", ten: "M")
    set result to result + digit_to_roman(digit: tens, one: "X", five: "L", ten: "C")
    set result to result + digit_to_roman(digit: ones, one: "I", five: "V", ten: "X")

    return result
  end
end

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral into an integer.
  example: from_roman(text: "MCMXCIV") is 1994

  if text.is_empty() then
    fail with RomanError(message: "roman numeral must not be empty")
  otherwise
    let total be 0
    let index be 0
    let previous_value be 0
    let repeat_count be 0
    let last_char be ""

    repeat until index is at least text.length()
      let current_char be text.drop(index).take(1)
      let current_value be roman_value(character: current_char)

      if current_value is 0 then
        fail with RomanError(message: "invalid roman numeral")
      otherwise
        if current_char is last_char then
          set repeat_count to repeat_count + 1
        otherwise
          set repeat_count to 1
        end

        if current_char is "V" or current_char is "L" or current_char is "D" then
          if repeat_count is greater than 1 then
            fail with RomanError(message: "invalid roman numeral")
          end
        end

        if current_value is greater than previous_value then
          if previous_value is 0 then
            set total to total + current_value
          otherwise if previous_value is 1 and current_value is greater than 10 then
            fail with RomanError(message: "invalid roman numeral")
          otherwise if previous_value is 10 and current_value is greater than 100 then
            fail with RomanError(message: "invalid roman numeral")
          otherwise if previous_value is 100 and current_value is greater than 1000 then
            fail with RomanError(message: "invalid roman numeral")
          otherwise
            set total to total + current_value - 2 * previous_value
          end
        otherwise
          set total to total + current_value
        end

        set previous_value to current_value
        set last_char to current_char
        set index to index + 1
      end
    end

    if total is less than 1 then
      fail with RomanError(message: "invalid roman numeral")
    otherwise if total is greater than 3999 then
      fail with RomanError(message: "roman numeral out of range")
    otherwise
      if to_roman(value: total) is not text then
        crash with "unreachable"
      end
      return total
    end
  end
end

function digit_to_roman(digit: Integer, one: Text, five: Text, ten: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Convert one decimal digit to Roman numeral fragments.

  if digit is 0 then
    return ""
  otherwise if digit is 1 then
    return one
  otherwise if digit is 2 then
    return one + one
  otherwise if digit is 3 then
    return one + one + one
  otherwise if digit is 4 then
    return one + five
  otherwise if digit is 5 then
    return five
  otherwise if digit is 6 then
    return five + one
  otherwise if digit is 7 then
    return five + one + one
  otherwise if digit is 8 then
    return five + one + one + one
  otherwise
    return one + ten
  end
end

function roman_value(character: Text)
  returns Integer
  purpose: Get the value of a single Roman numeral character.

  if character is "I" then
    return 1
  otherwise if character is "V" then
    return 5
  otherwise if character is "X" then
    return 10
  otherwise if character is "L" then
    return 50
  otherwise if character is "C" then
    return 100
  otherwise if character is "D" then
    return 500
  otherwise if character is "M" then
    return 1000
  otherwise
    return 0
  end
end

module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert between integers and Roman numerals.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: Errors for invalid Roman numeral conversions.
  InvalidInteger(value: Integer)
  InvalidRoman(text: Text)
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 into a Roman numeral.
  example: to_roman(value: 1994) is "MCMXCIV"

  if value is less than 1 then
    fail with InvalidInteger(value: value)
  end

  if value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidInteger(value: value)
  end

  let thousands be value.quotient(1000)
  let hundreds be value.remainder(1000).quotient(100)
  let tens be value.remainder(100).quotient(10)
  let ones be value.remainder(10)

  let result be ""
  set result to result + repeat_roman(symbol: "M", count: thousands)
  set result to result + digit_roman(digit: hundreds, one: "C", five: "D", ten: "M")
  set result to result + digit_roman(digit: tens, one: "X", five: "L", ten: "C")
  set result to result + digit_roman(digit: ones, one: "I", five: "V", ten: "X")
  return result
end

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral into an integer.
  example: from_roman(text: "MCMXCIV") is 1994

  if text.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
  end

  let total be 0
  let index be 0
  let length be text.length()

  repeat until index is at least length
    let current be roman_value(character: text.characters().at(index))
    if current is 0 then
      fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
    end

    if index + 1 is less than length then
      let next be roman_value(character: text.characters().at(index + 1))
      if next is 0 then
        fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
      end

      if current is less than next then
        if not valid_subtractive_pair(left: current, right: next) then
          fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
        end
        set total to total + (next - current)
        set index to index + 2
      otherwise
        set total to total + current
        set index to index + 1
      end
    otherwise
      set total to total + current
      set index to index + 1
    end
  end

  if total is less than 1 then
    fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
  end

  if total is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
  end

  if to_roman(value: total) is not text then
    fail with InvalidRoman(text: text)
  end

  return total
end

function repeat_roman(symbol: Text, count: Integer)
  returns Text
  purpose: Repeat a Roman symbol a fixed number of times.

  let result be ""
  let index be 0
  repeat until index is at least count
    set result to result + symbol
    set index to index + 1
  end
  return result
end

function digit_roman(digit: Integer, one: Text, five: Text, ten: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Convert one decimal digit into Roman numeral form.

  if digit is 0 then
    return ""
  end

  if digit is 1 then
    return one
  end

  if digit is 2 then
    return one + one
  end

  if digit is 3 then
    return one + one + one
  end

  if digit is 4 then
    return one + five
  end

  if digit is 5 then
    return five
  end

  if digit is 6 then
    return five + one
  end

  if digit is 7 then
    return five + one + one
  end

  if digit is 8 then
    return five + one + one + one
  end

  return one + ten
end

function roman_value(character: Text)
  returns Integer
  purpose: Map a Roman numeral character to its value.

  if character is "I" then
    return 1
  end
  if character is "V" then
    return 5
  end
  if character is "X" then
    return 10
  end
  if character is "L" then
    return 50
  end
  if character is "C" then
    return 100
  end
  if character is "D" then
    return 500
  end
  if character is "M" then
    return 1000
  end
  return 0
end

function valid_subtractive_pair(left: Integer, right: Integer)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Check whether a subtractive Roman pair is allowed.

  if left is 1 then
    return right is 5 or right is 10
  end
  if left is 10 then
    return right is 50 or right is 100
  end
  if left is 100 then
    return right is 500 or right is 1000
  end
  return false
end
end
